purpose: Calibration baseline for the 2003-04 game engine. A season is simulated on the environment of the last completed season, never on its own final averages.

verification.method: Supplied Basketball-Reference league averages and pinned mirror provenance; player totals and recomputable rates validated locally. External ESPN cross-check was reported by the data collector, not independently repeated by this importer.

sources.notes: League Average row of the Per Game Stats team table. Read from the page by an automated reader, then checked against sums of the player totals in this file.

sources.provider: Basketball-Reference, via the sumitrodatta/nba-alt-awards GitHub copy
sources.notes: Pace only: League Average row for season 2003.

engine_assumptions.status: provisional structural assumptions, not sourced league data

team_turnover_note: Inferred residual: published team TOV minus summed individual TOV / (29 * 82). Includes source rounding; treated as unassigned team turnovers, not player turnovers.
